titleFront: Plead My Case To The Senate

flipToBack.prose: Flip if you have 3+ of your senators AT Galactic Senate, or 2+ of your senators AT Galactic Senate at least one of which has a peace agenda. Count is a filterActive collection size, spotting includes excluded-from-battle. Neither control nor occupation of the site is required.

children.req: card-count >= 3 of your senators AT the site (filterActive size, INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE)
card-count >= 2 of your senators AT the site
chosen-state: at least one of those senators has peace agenda

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if you have fewer than two of your senators AT Galactic Senate.

children.req: card-count >= 2 of your senators AT Galactic Senate (canSpot with count 2, INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE)

requirementSemantics: Both flip laws are pure card-count checks over Filters.at(Filters.Galactic_Senate) - the AT relation, NOT control, NOT occupy, NOT 'present at'. Opponent's presence at the Senate is irrelevant to both flips.
'Senator' is checked via Filters.senator (see standing rule: senator detection combines Keyword.SENATOR and lore scan in the engine filter).
'Peace agenda' is a per-card agenda state (Filters.peace_agenda) checked only within the already-collected senators at the Senate.
No place-out-of-play condition on either side.
The back flips back the moment you drop below 2 senators at the Senate - a maintenance obligation, no phase restriction.

setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game (required, from Reserve Deck): Galactic Senate (Card12_088.java:61), any other [Episode I] location = Filters.and(Icon.EPISODE_I, Filters.location, Filters.not(Filters.Galactic_Senate)) (Card12_088.java:68).
BACK: once per turn, take a Political Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (Card12_088_BACK.java:109-122, GameTextActionId.SANITY_AND_COMPASSION__UPLOAD_POLITICAL_EFFECT).
FRONT (remainder of game, granted after deployment completes): may deploy cards stacked on your Political Effects as if from hand (MayDeployAsIfFromHandModifier, Card12_088.java:107-109).
otherObligations: FOR REMAINDER OF GAME (survive flips, granted via AddUntilEndOfGameModifierEffect at deployment completion, Card12_088.java:78-157): Rebel and Imperial leaders of ability < 4 are politics +2; Counter Assault and Surprise Assault are auto-canceled; weapon destiny draws at Galactic Senate are -6; creatures at Galactic Senate are lost (required singleton trigger); game text of active non-Republic characters at Galactic Senate is canceled.
BACK: once during your control phase, use 3 Force to place up to two random cards from opponent's hand into their Used Pile (Card12_088_BACK.java:64-104).
BACK: your senators are +2 (characters with order agenda +3) when drawn for battle or weapon destiny (Card12_088_BACK.java:128-138).
BACK: at end of turn, may use 2 Force to place all cards on your Political Effects into Used Pile (Card12_088_BACK.java:141-164).
Rando obligation implied by flip-back: keep >= 2 (ideally 3) senators physically at Galactic Senate at all times while on back.

missingStateCalculation: ObjectiveAnalyzer evaluates the front in exact CNF: every route needs two senators at Galactic Senate, then either a third senator or a peace-agenda senator among that location-scoped actor set.

Two agenda-less senators satisfy only the floor. Three senators satisfy both rules. Two senators with the exact peace agenda satisfy both rules. A blockade agenda does not complete the Light alternative.
On the back, the analyzer arms flip-back risk only when the owner count at Galactic Senate is one or zero. Two senators are stable.
flipPreservation: V108 makes a senator deploy beat a generic character and Pass; V88 makes Galactic Senate beat the other Episode I setup site.
An exact pre-flip senator-to-Senate deployment releases only Formation Safety's ordinary unsupported-solo defer. The contested weak-solo hard block remains dominant.

Before flip, a counted senator is held while its removal would leave neither the three-senator route nor the two-plus-peace route complete. Redundant senators release when another exact route survives.
After flip, either of the last two senators is protected against movement, standalone Force loss, and battle forfeit while another legal expendable card exists. A third senator is redundant.
runtimeOwners: ObjectiveAnalyzer owns the shared historical Senate-family identity, typed profile hydration, exact CNF state, counted onTable removal arithmetic, and pre-flip/post-flip formation roles.
The existing V83/V88/V108/V110 deploy adjustments own senator priority, Galactic Senate destination priority, off-site penalties, and non-senator holds without new magnitudes.
Mirrored CardSelectionEvaluator adapters release only the exact unsupported-solo defer and preserve Formation Safety's hard danger result.
MoveObjectiveGateHoldPolicy, ForceLossPolicy V109, and BattleForfeitPolicy consume the shared counted formation roles. Rando and Chosen One use identical owners and winners.
contradictions: Control or occupation of Galactic Senate is not required. The law counts the owner's senators at that location.
The agenda shortcut is peace for this Light printing. Blockade agenda is the Dark sibling's route and must remain neutral here.
Exactly three agenda-less senators are not redundant before the flip: removing one leaves two agenda-less senators and breaks the front condition. A fourth plain senator is redundant.
The structured actor-count rules, not null legacy flipGateSite or empty flipGateCardIds fields, own the exact gate.
The profile was inert before commit 4942781ab. An ungated V99 Senate blocker alone did not accumulate senators or preserve the back.
